title: SDK docs scratchpad & to-dos
content:
Quick personal scratchpad for SDK/docs work — rough, unordered. Notes to self and immediate to-dos for next week.

Top goals (short-term):
- Close doc gaps in quickstart: streaming example + tool-calling snippet + common errors section.
- Ship two small sample apps: node-chat-widget + python-embeddings-search demo.
- Fix tutorial flow for 'hosted -> dedicated' migration doc (confusing config names).

Observed gaps / TODO candidates:
1) Quickstart (GET STARTED)
   - Missing streaming code example for Node/TS; current sample only shows sync response. Add simple server-sent-events example and client consumption snippet.
   - Tool calling example exists in SDK reference but not in quickstart. Add minimal function signature + example invocation.
   - Error mapping: show common error codes (401, 429, 503) and recommended retry/backoff.

2) Auth & config docs
   - Clarify KMS/HSM note for Private installs (customer confusion on what to provide). Add example env var names and config snippet.
   - Dedicated vs Hosted config: rename "reserve_capacity" to "dedicated_pool" in docs to match actual config schema (ticket JIRA-DEV-456).

3) Sample apps
   - node-chat-widget: minimal UI + streaming + fallback to smaller model. Needs README, deployment instruction (Vercel), and env var examples.
   - python-embeddings-search: ingest script + small sample dataset + notebook showing L2 vs cosine results. Include instructions for using embeddings with vector DB (we recommend Milvus/pgvector).

4) Tutorials and migration guides
   - Migration tutorial (hosted -> dedicated): current step "update model endpoint" ambiguous. Add explicit steps: update model name, update routing policy, test with 1000 reqs/day.
   - Add a troubleshooting section: common gotchas (KV cache warmup, batch sizing causing latency spikes).

5) SDK Reference completeness
   - Missing param docs for `create_stream` options: `max_latency_ms` and `batch_priority`. Add descriptions and typical values.
   - Examples for language-specific SDKs should show best practices: typed responses, response parsing helpers.

Immediate action items (next 3 days) — assign and rough estimate:
- [ ] Add Node streaming example to quickstart (me) — 3h.
- [ ] Add tool-calling minimal example to quickstart (Aisha) — 2h.
- [ ] Update config names in migration doc to match schema (Miguel) — 1h.
- [ ] Create repo skeleton for node-chat-widget sample + README template (me) — 4h.
- [ ] Draft python embeddings README + ingest script (Aisha) — 4h.

Notes / snippets to copy into docs:
- Node streaming minimal (pseudo):
  const res = await client.streamCompletion({ model: 'redwood/gpt-4o-mini', prompt: 'hi', onDelta: (d) => socket.send(d) });
  // show SSE example for browser consumption

- Tool calling minimal (pseudo):
  const tools = [{ name: 'get-weather', spec: { city: 'string' }, call: async (args) => fetchWeather(args.city) }];
  const reply = await client.chat({ model: 'redwood/chat-1', messages, tools });

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Do we want to surface quantization recommendations in the quickstart or keep that in Optimize? (prob keep in Optimize but link from quickstart)
- Validate wording for "private deployment KMS" with security team before publishing. (Ping: security@redwood)
- How to represent cost estimates in sample apps (show per-request token cost)? Might confuse users — maybe add an appendix.

Links to reference I keep hitting:
- GH SDK repo PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/342 (current WIP for streaming api)
- Confluence draft: CONFLUENCE-DEVEXP-123 (migration guide draft)
- JIRA ticket: JIRA-DEV-456 (config rename)

Publishing checklist before marking docs as final:
- [ ] Tech review (eng owning API)
- [ ] Security KMS wording review
- [ ] Run sample apps CI and verify deploy instructions
- [ ] Add short video / gif for streaming UX

Misc quick notes:
- Consider adding a small "FAQ for prototyping" box in quickstart: model choice, latency vs cost, what to use for POCs.
- Might add a tiny benchmark table: typical latency for models on hosted at 1k tokens, 10k tokens. Keep it lightweight.

End of scratchpad. Will move actionable items to JIRA after initial drafts ready.
